citations.claim: controller force 250.34 exceeds fmax 194.58 at first violating step
initial speed before violation showing large velocity error

counterfactual.change: Reduced kp from 26.4 to 10 (single field change) so that commanded force stays within fmax; counterfactual passes with no controller_force_limit violation.

explanation: Controller force at step 1 is 250.34 N exceeding fmax 194.58 N. The velocity-error law kp * (v_desired - v_actual) computes force proportional to kp=26.4 and large initial velocity error/magnitude without clamping to fmax. Reducing kp to 10 eliminates the violation, confirming unbounded force calculation is the cause.
vision_note: Frame 0 shows the red controller-driven body on the left side of the arena with the green waypoint distant up and to the right. Between step 0 and step 1 the body shows almost no visible displacement, while the waypoint remains unchanged, giving no visual cue of the magnitude of force being applied.
